description: Query options for resolving shared notifications.

members.name: RecipientUserId
members.description: Recipient user id whose notifications should be returned.

members.name: SearchText
members.description: Optional free-text filter matched against title, body, and actor fields.

members.name: IncludeRead
members.description: When false, only unread notifications are returned.

members.name: Skip
members.description: Number of matching notifications to skip.

members.name: Take
members.description: Maximum number of matching notifications to return.
